args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` showed checkout-api running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed with status `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback to v2.3.0.

## Verification

Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, with error rate dropped to 0.002.
